page_title: BRE 2-2 TOT | Brentford v Tottenham Hotspur 13/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Robert Jones has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Ivan Perisic (Tottenham).
90+1' The corner is swung in but Tottenham can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90+1' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Tottenham earn a corner.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
86' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) takes the free kick and sends the ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready.
84' Thomas Frank has decided to make a change. Zanka (Brentford) replaces Kristoffer Ajer.
79' Kevin Schade (Brentford) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
76' Direct free kick. Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) attempts to beat the opposition's defence with a fine lofted pass into the penalty box, but one of the defenders reacts well and averts the threat.
75' Substitution. Oliver Skipp did his best and is replaced by Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham).
75' Here is a change. Heung-Min Son is going off and Ange Postecoglou gives the last tactical orders to Ivan Perisic (Tottenham).
72' Here's the change. Christian Norgaard leaves the pitch and Shandon Baptiste (Brentford) comes on as a substitute.
72' Thomas Frank decides to make a substitution. Aaron Hickey will be replaced by Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford).
72' The game has come to an end for Yoane Wissa. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Kevin Schade (Brentford).
71' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Robert Jones who sees an offensive foul.
66' The referee blows his whistle as Emerson Royal (Tottenham) was too aggressive in his challenge.
64' Richarlison (Tottenham) gets inside the box and tries to beat Mark Flekken with a measured shot into the right side of the goal, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
63' James Maddison (Tottenham) sends a lofted cross into the box from the free kick, but Mark Flekken guesses his intention and plucks the ball out of the air.
62' Today's referee Robert Jones rightly decides to book Aaron Hickey (Brentford) for his harsh tackle.
60' James Maddison (Tottenham) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
60' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Tottenham will take a corner kick.
59' Rico Henry (Brentford) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
58' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) tries to put the rebound into the net from the edge of the box, but the goalkeeper pulls off a good save to deny him.
58' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
55' A corner kick by Tottenham is thwarted by the well prepared Mark Flekken (Brentford).
53' Tottenham fail to score from a corner as Mark Flekken (Brentford) leaps to collect the ball.
52' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Tottenham. Tottenham force their opponents to concede a corner.
49' Thomas Frank prepares a substitution. Mathias Jensen is replaced by Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford).
48' James Maddison (Tottenham) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Mark Flekken is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+12' Robert Jones has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+10' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) spurned a good chance! He gets a shot away from inside the penalty box, but it goes just over the bar.
45+7' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
45+7' The foul by Rico Henry (Brentford) was seen by Robert Jones who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
45+4' 2 - 2 Goal! James Maddison tees up Emerson Royal (Tottenham) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the bottom left corner. 2:2.
45+4' A rebound spins to Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) inside the box, but his sliced shot flies just wide of the left post.
45' 11 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' The referee gives a yellow card to Oliver Skipp (Tottenham).
43' Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) hammers the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked by an opposition player.
36' 2 - 1 Yoane Wissa (Brentford) collects a killer pass and fires a low shot into the middle of the net, giving the goalkeeper no chance.
36' James Maddison (Tottenham) fails to control his temper and is booked by the referee for dissent.
36' Robert Jones shows a yellow card to Davinson Sanchez (Tottenham) for a tough tackle.
36' Good clearance! Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) receives a brilliant short pass and finds himself in a good position inside the box, but he's robbed of the ball by one of the defending players.
33' Robert Jones has a clear sight and sees a foul from Davinson Sanchez (Tottenham).
26' 1 - 1 Goal! Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Guglielmo Vicario to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom left corner.
26' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) is going to take the penalty!
26' Guglielmo Vicario (Tottenham) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Robert Jones lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
25' It’s a PENALTY to Brentford after the VAR review!
24' Referee Robert Jones makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Brentford. Let’s see what happens!
24' Emerson Royal (Tottenham) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
23' PENALTY APPEAL by Brentford, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
21' Brentford take a short corner kick.
18' Rico Henry (Brentford) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but Guglielmo Vicario has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
18' The ball goes out for a corner. Brentford can continue in their attacking effort.

17' Aaron Hickey (Brentford) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Brentford.
17' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Brentford comes to nothing.

16' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the left-hand post. Guglielmo Vicario is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him. Brentford have a corner.
14' Problems for Ange Postecoglou as Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Davinson Sanchez replaces him.
14' Robert Jones sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
12' The Tottenham players halt their celebrations as referee Robert Jones makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.

11' 0 - 1 GOAL! James Maddison curls the free kick into the box. Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) peels off his marker and arrows a brilliant header past Mark Flekken and into the right side of the net. 0:1.
10' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) commits a rough challenge and Robert Jones blows his whistle for a foul. Tottenham are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
9' Now Tottenham have a corner.
9' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The referee blows his whistle, Tottenham are awarded a corner kick.
8' Mark Flekken displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Richarlison (Tottenham) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
7' The ball is cleared after James Maddison (Tottenham) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
6' Tottenham seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
3' Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Brentford will kick the game off.
Robert Jones is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
